    Right modules, representation-finite algebras, and the radical of ind(mod A) #

    Conventions of the manuscript (main.tex): modules are finite-dimensional right modules, and maps compose from left to right, so the manuscript's fg is Lean's f ≫ g.

    • Right A-modules are modelled as ModuleCat Aᵐᵒᵖ.
    • IsRepresentationFinite k A: finitely many isomorphism classes of finite-dimensional indecomposable right modules. Borrowed from the magnitude-conjecture formalization, MagnitudeConjecture/Algebra/RightModuleFiniteType.lean (commit 3ac9f6a22).
    • IndSkeleton k A: one representative of each isomorphism class of finite-dimensional indecomposable right modules, indexed by Fin n; the full subcategory on them is ind(mod A).
    • The categorical radical J of ind(mod A) and its powers: J(X, Y) is spanned by the radical morphisms f (those with 1 - f g invertible for all g : Y ⟶ X), and J^{n+1}(X, Y) is spanned by composites f g with f radical and g ∈ J^n, all intermediate objects being indecomposable (graded-category.tex).
    • Irr(X, Y) = J(X, Y) / J²(X, Y).
    • Almost split sequences.
